app.name: evo-agents hub
app.description: The team's shared store for memories, skills, plans and knowledge graphs.

login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Sign in to evo-agents hub
login.description: Use your GitHub account. The hub reads only your GitHub login and never stores a GitHub token.
login.notConfigured: Web sign-in is not enabled on this hub. An administrator needs to set the client secret, the session secret and the hub's public URL.
login.unreachable: The hub API cannot be reached. Reload the page in a few minutes.
login.access: You only see the projects an administrator has granted to your account.
login.cli: On your machine, sign the CLI in with evo-agents hub login.

projectSwitcher.label: Projects
projectSwitcher.none: No project has been granted to you yet
projectSwitcher.loadError: The project list could not be loaded
projectSwitcher.hint: Open a project to see its content

userMenu.grants: {count, plural, =0 {No project grants yet} one {Granted on # project} other {Granted on # projects}}
userMenu.logoutFailed: Sign-out did not go through. Try again in a moment.

home.title: My projects
home.description: The projects the hub returns for your account, with your role and the highest label level you may see.
home.count: {count, plural, =0 {No projects} one {# project} other {# projects}}
home.emptyTitle: No project has been granted to you yet
home.emptyDescription: Ask a hub administrator to grant a role to {login}, then reload this page.

project.title: Project overview
project.noHarness: The project was registered without its harness paths.
project.adminWithoutGrant: You are a hub administrator without a role in this project: you can manage it but cannot read its content.

ladder.title: Label ladder
ladder.description: Levels from lowest to highest. You see content labelled up to your max level.

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: The repos declared in the project's harness.
repos.name: Repo

sinks.title: Sinks
sinks.description: Where the project's content may go, with the highest label level allowed there.

admin.title: Hub administration
admin.description: The number of rows in each hub table. Only hub administrators can see this page.

readOnly.label: Read-only page
readOnly.text: This page is read-only. Plans are changed with evo harness step or evo-agents hub plan; every change adds a revision to the history.

list.title: Plans
list.description: The project's plans as the hub holds them, with progress counted in steps done.
list.noActive: The project has no active plan.
list.noCompleted: The project has no completed plan yet.
list.emptyTitle: The project has no plan on the hub yet
list.emptyDescription: Push the harness's plans with evo-agents hub plan import, then reload this page. Plans labelled above your level do not show here.
list.search: Search plans by title or id

board.title: Steps
board.search: Search steps by id, title, repo or content

step.unknownStep: The plan has no such step
step.noWhat: The step does not say what to do.
step.noVerify: The step does not say how to verify it.
step.evidenceVerbatim: Kept verbatim, as written in the plan.
step.noEvidence: No evidence yet: the step is not done.
step.noEvidenceDone: The step is done but records no evidence.

repos.title: Repos and merge order
repos.caption: The repos the plan touches, in merge order

notFound.title: Plan {plan} not found
notFound.description: The plan is not in project {project}, or its label is above the level you may read.
notFound.stepDescription: Check the step id in the address, or open the plan to see its steps.

history.title: Revision history
history.onlyOne: The plan has one revision so far; there is nothing to compare.
history.sameRevision: Both choices are the same revision. Pick two different revisions to see what changed.

diff.added: {count, plural, one {+# line added} other {+# lines added}}
diff.removed: {count, plural, one {-# line removed} other {-# lines removed}}
diff.context: {count, plural, one {with # unchanged line around each change} other {with # unchanged lines around each change}}
diff.noChange: The two revisions read the same.
diff.hunkCaption: Part {index}, lines {from} to {to} of the old text and {newFrom} to {newTo} of the new text

states.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this page
states.forbiddenDescription: The hub API refused the request for your account. If you need access, ask a hub administrator for a suitable role.
states.notFoundDescription: This page does not exist, or it belongs to a project you cannot see.
states.projectNotFoundDescription: The project is not registered on the hub, or you have not been granted access to it.
states.serverErrorTitle: The hub failed to handle the request
states.serverErrorDescription: Try again in a few minutes. If it keeps failing, send the request id below to an administrator.
states.networkErrorTitle: The hub API cannot be reached
states.networkErrorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
states.clientErrorTitle: The API did not accept the request
states.unexpectedDescription: Reload the page. If it keeps failing, send the reference below to an administrator.
